basic_info.description: Nestled in the vibrant Excelsior neighborhood, this modernized Edwardian home offers both classic charm and smart upgrades. Bay windows reveal sweeping views, and the terraced garden boasts a new deck and mature landscaping, creating a peaceful outdoor retreat. The easy, functionally planned main level includes a spacious living room with high ceilings, dining area, a large eat-in kitchen with garden access, two bedrooms, and a full bathroom with both tub and shower. The lower level provides a generously sized bonus space, a second bathroom, an unfinished laundry room and direct access to the backyard. The one-car garage is accessible from the street level. With a newly installed roof, freshly painted inside and outside, polished hardwood floors, new carpets and more, this home is move-in ready. Set in a prime location, a block away from Excelsior Playground and just blocks from McLaren Park, San Francisco's second largest park, with shopping, dining, public transit and freeway access, this Excelsior gem is ready for its next chapter.
